messages:
lia: Quick follow-up from today's All-Hands  security/compliance section. I'm collecting a short checklist for PMs building features that touch logs/keys/data residency. Can we use this thread for clarifying?

lia: Questions: 1) Where do we store the canonical SOC2 evidence artifacts and who can share them with customers? 2) For DSARs, what is the self-serve path vs. support-assisted? 3) Key escrow: do we maintain an emergency-escrow for BYOK in Private deployments? 4) Cross-region log residency: can customers force logs to remain in-region?

maria: Nice. Answers short first: SOC2 artifacts = internal evidence bundle (read-only) + auditor portal. DSARs = support-assisted for hosted; Dedicated/Private can self-serve exports if configured. BYOK escrow = NOT by default; Private can opt-in for escrow signing; Dedicated can use customer KMS with optional escrow under contract. Region residency = yes for Private; Hosted is multi-region default but we offer region restriction controls for enterprise.

kevin: Adding infra detail: evidence bundle path (internal) -> https://redwood.company/security/evidence/soc2-current.zip (internal only). Auditor portal: auditors@redwood access via SSO with time-limited tokens.

kevin: DSAR flow (short):
```
1. Customer files DSAR -> Support ticket
2. Verify identity -> Legal review
3. Trigger export job -> Delivery via secure S3 link (7d expiry)
```
Hosted: manual by Support (we can accelerate). Dedicated/Private: teams can configure automatic export to customer S3.

sasha: Legal note: Any evidence shared externally must go through the auditor portal or an approved non-disclosure. For DSARs, redact employer IDs if requested. Requesters need the ALA (Access & Logging Agreement) signed for key/export requests.

dan: On key escrow: operationally we avoid holding plaintext backups of customer keys. For BYOK escrow we implement split-key escrow with HSM-backed shares; activation requires an approved change request + dual-operator sign-off. We log all escrow access into the audit pipeline.

lia: Helpful. For PMs: do we have a short one-pager explaining what features are allowed with/without BYOK? (e.g. embeddings storage, logs, SSO integrations)

maria: I'll produce a one-pager. Draft outline: Scope (which data types), Allowed by default (hosted: no BYOK), Customer opt-in flows (Dedicated/Private), Escrow option & legal requirements, Rotation & overlap policy, Evidence & audit trail. Target: first draft in 4 business days.

eli: Two technical asks from PMs: (A) example API/webhook payload for "audit.export.ready" so we can wire notifications; (B) sample Terraform snippet to enable S3 export and IAM role.

kevin: Example webhook payload:
```json
{ "event":"audit.export.ready", "job_id":"job-92ab","s3_url":"https://s3.amazonaws.com/acme/exports/job-92ab.jsonl.gz","expires":"2026-05-01T12:00:00Z" }
```
And sample Terraform for S3 permissions will be in the doc I promised earlier.

maria: Rotation policy: Redwood-managed keys rotate every 90 days; BYOK rotation cadence is customer-controlled BUT we require a minimum 30-day dual-key overlap and a signed rotation plan in the ALA for escrowed keys.

lia: About region residency: who approves a customer's request to keep logs only in eu-west-1? Any perf/cost impacts?

kevin: Approval: Product + Security + Sales must sign off for hosted customers; Dedicated/Private: customer can set region but needs capacity reservation. Cost: extra, depending on replication avoidance and retention.

audit-bot: Created ticket SEC-8777 "BYOK escrow process - doc + template ALA" assigned to sasha, dan, maria. ETA: 3 weeks.

sasha: I'll draft the ALA template and include clauses for escrow, deletion requests, and auditor access. Will add examples of signature language.

dan: Ops note: any escrow activation path will require an on-call approval and an SRE runbook. I'll start the runbook and post a link here when available.

lia: Great. Last Q: can we get a short public-facing FAQ line for sales? Eg: "Do you hold customer keys?" One sentence.

maria: Public FAQ line: "By default, we manage encryption keys for hosted customers; enterprises using Dedicated or Private can provide their own keys (BYOK) and may opt into an escrow arrangement under contract." Feel free to shorten for sales.

eli: Thanks  I'll collect PM questions and drop them here.

lia: Thanks team. Will wait for the one-pager and ALA template. If anyone else has follow-ups, add them here or ping me.
